title: gepr102
subject: English
summary: Wit and Humour Unit 2 WIT AND HUMOUR Animals, Birds, and Dr. Dolittle Let us do these activities before we read. I Do you have a pet or a domestic animal? How do people usually spend time with a pet or domestic animal? Share your thoughts with your classmates and the teacher. II You must have read stories where animals and birds talk. If you had a chance to communicate with an animal or a bird, who would you like to speak to and why? III If we closely observe the body language of animals and birds, we can understand what they want to tell us. Work in pairs and study the pictures given below. Find out what emotions these animals and birds are trying to convey.
